ground_truth_witness: Let C be the walking-arrow category with f:0→1, D the terminal category, and X=Bool. Define bifunctors constant on objects at X. Set F(f,id)=id_X and G(f,id)=swap, with identities mapped to identities. Let α_(0,*)=id_X and α_(1,*)=swap. Naturality in D is vacuous; naturality in C holds because G(f,id)∘α_(0,*)=swap=α_(1,*)∘F(f,id).
